sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is the latest model in the MiniCPM-V series, available in a 35B-A3B variant, with 35B-A3B being the first MoE model in the MiniCPM-V series. It builds on the family's single-image, multi-image, and video understanding capabilities, combining stronger foundation capabilities with efficient visual encoding and on-device inference.

sources.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.7 MiniCPM-V is a series of efficient multimodal large language models developed by OpenBMB. Like MiniCPM-V 4.6, the MiniCPM-V 4.7 architecture pairs a SigLIP vision encoder that has a window-attention merger with a Qwen3.5 language model backbone, and supports both 4x and 16x visual downsampling modes.

sources.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B - OpenBMB - LLM Database
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B is a public OpenBMB vision-language checkpoint uploaded on October 6. Its official repository contains 16 downloadable BF16 weight shards totaling approximately 35.21B parameters, a hybrid linear/full-attention mixture-of-experts language configuration, and image/video processing metadata. The configuration permits 262,144 positions, but no model card or validated context ...

sources.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B A3B - VRAM, Specs & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: About MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B A3B MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B A3B is a mixture-of-experts multimodal foundation model featuring 3B active parameters per token. It delivers efficient high-resolution image and video comprehension with strong reasoning capabilities.
